title: Second Inaugural Address (excerpt)
author: Abraham Lincoln

source.title: Abraham Lincoln's Second Inaugural Address
source.to: lasting peace among ourselves, and with all nations.

intro: 1865年3月4日，林肯在华盛顿国会大厦东廊发表第二次就职演说，当时内战已接近尾声。他反思战争的起因，认为奴隶制是这场战争的根源之一，并多次引用《圣经》语句。末段 “With malice toward none” 语气平和而坚定，是全篇的收束。
tips: “With malice toward none; with charity for all” 两组并列，分号处稍停。
“firmness in the right” 后放慢，末句 “a just and lasting peace” 略收束。
